cues: Here is acetic acid titrated with sodium hydroxide.
The vertical jump runs from about seven to about eleven.
Methyl orange's range is far below it, so it would change colour too early, long before the equivalence point.
Phenolphthalein's range sits right inside the jump.
text: So how do we choose? Here is acetic acid titrated with sodium hydroxide. The vertical jump runs from about seven to about eleven. Methyl orange's range is far below it, so it would change colour too early, long before the equivalence point. Phenolphthalein's range sits right inside the jump.
